description: This tilted horizontal bar chart illustrates the number of tasks associated with various language families or groups. The logical vertical axis contains the categories, representing different language groups, without an explicit axis label. The logical horizontal axis represents the value, labeled "# tasks", featuring a linear scale with a visible range from 0 to 80 and tick marks at regular intervals of 10, accompanied by corresponding grid lines. The chart displays ten individual bars, each assigned a distinct color and outlined in black, sorted in descending order of their value from top to bottom. The tallest bar at the top represents IE-Slavic in light blue with an approximate value of 58 tasks. This is followed by IE-Romance (medium blue, ~48), IE-Germanic (light green, ~45), Uralic (dark green, ~22), IE-Baltic (pink, ~18), IE-other (red, ~16), IE-Indic (light orange, ~12), Semitic (orange, ~10), and Turkic (light purple, ~5). The shortest bar at the bottom represents Basque in dark purple with an approximate value of 3 tasks. The entire chart is presented at a rotated angle, though the relationship between the category and value axes remains standard for a horizontal bar chart.
